name: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection
mechanism: Reranks a bounded visual candidate set by estimated downstream evidence utility rather than semantic similarity alone.
use_when: First-stage visual recall is adequate but plausible images are unhelpful
Answer utility can be evaluated by modality slice
avoid_when: The relevant page is absent from the candidate pool
The utility surrogate is unvalidated for the serving model
expected_effects: More useful evidence among final visual candidates
